In detail

An affluent, hilly, mostly residential Buda district (Svábhegy, Normafa). A July 2025 crime-hotspot map built from the prior month's citywide police data named Districts I and XII explicitly as "exceptionally safe," and it does not appear in any theft, burglary, or disorder hotspot list checked for this build. Sources checked: Metropol.hu, 20 Jul 2025 (30-day crime-hotspot map).
